Relations.title: Relations
Relations.empty: No relations yet. Link this snippet to others with a free-form label.
Relations.label: Label
Relations.labelHint: How it reads from this snippet, for example “father of” or “ally of”. Labels already used in this world are suggested.
Relations.inverseHint: How it reads from the other snippet, for example “child of”. If empty, the one already tied to this label in the world is reused.
Relations.validityHint: Optional. The year is required; month and day when needed.

RelationTypes.title: Relation types
RelationTypes.intro: Define recurring labels with their inverse and, if you like, the categories that may be linked. Relations whose label matches a type follow its constraints; others stay free-form.
RelationTypes.empty: No relation types yet. Free-form relations work regardless.
RelationTypes.label: Label
RelationTypes.constraintHint: With a category chosen, only snippets of that category can be linked with this label. Existing relations do not change. Renaming or deleting a type does not change existing relations, which keep their label (now free-form).
RelationTypes.readOnly: Only owners and editors can edit types.
